source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Since we already have the financial-model template and the data, we need someone to check that data and refine the model. Hello Elias—could you confirm whether you can do this and tell me how much you would charge?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Attached are the Excel template and additional project information for your review, Elias. We are currently preparing a financial model for government submission in connection with a potential PPP project.

For the project to be viable and bankable, a key requirement is that the model clearly demonstrate and justify the need for availability-style payments. Please confirm whether you can support us in developing it. There may be errors that need checking, and we also need the finished model to look professional, clear, and strongly presented.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Because the government will review the model, please ensure the modeling is flawless and the work is completed to a high standard.

value_updates.modeling_quality_standard: Flawless, high-standard modeling suitable for government review

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: To ensure the final numbers make sense and appear credible, please review the model thoroughly. You may make any changes that would improve it.

value_updates.output_credibility_standard: Final numbers must make sense and appear credible

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: As I said earlier, requesting accountability for the delivered work is not exploitative, so that accusation does not make sense. The material you provided contains many errors, is difficult to understand and is of poor quality; you also know it is subpar. Instead of spending more time on repeated revisions, I hired another freelancer to restart the work from scratch. I therefore do not want to continue this engagement. Even so, my intention is not to leave a negative review or end matters on bad terms.

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that the delivered model contains many errors and requires rebuilding from scratch.

routing_warnings.description: The client's inability to understand the presentation and follow how figures were generated primarily concerns model comprehensibility.
The clause about dashboards failing to show returns, debt performance, and bankability concerns the dashboard Requirement.
The claim that every number traces to a source on the Assumptions tab concerns assumption disclosure and traceability rather than calculation integrity.
The freelancer's claim about providing a simplified dashboard is implementation evidence for the dashboard Requirement, not a target-specific calculation-integrity claim.
